latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Audio TTS — Convert Text to Video Voiceover.

- Converts text/scripts into AI voiceover synced to video, supporting MP4, MOV, TXT, and DOCX files up to 200MB.
- Cloud GPU processing delivers 1080p MP4 outputs in 20–45 seconds.
- Automatic setup with free token and session management—no installation needed.
- Supports content creators and marketers with easy voiceover workflows and batch processing.
- Handles user prompts for exporting, credits check, status, and uploads; clear error handling and detailed usage tips included.
